headline: The US is banning foreign robots
summary: The US government is implementing a new import ban targeting China. The ban includes 'advanced robotic devices' and power inverters made in foreign countries. Specifically mentioned are 'mobile' robots, such as humanoid and quadruped models.

headline: Ariana Grande is suing the hackers who’ve been leaking her songs and videos for years
summary: Ariana Grande has filed a lawsuit in Los Angeles against unidentified hackers. The suit aims to reveal the identities of those who allegedly stole and leaked private content. Hackers are accused of leaking her songs and videos over several years.

headline: The union drive at the Wikimedia Foundation is expanding
summary: UK staff at the Wikimedia Foundation first announced their intention to unionize in June. Now, US-based employees are joining the unionization effort. Wikimedia management has declined to voluntarily recognize the US union.

headline: eBay’s bizarre cyberstalking saga ends with a $56 million settlement
summary: eBay and three former executives will pay $55.7 million in a settlement. The payment resolves a bizarre harassment and cyberstalking campaign from 2019. Former eBay executives sent live insects, a bloody pig mask, and other disturbing items to a Massachusetts couple.

headline: GTA Online In-game Gambling Suddenly Disabled in Australia
summary: In-game gambling features in GTA Online have been suddenly disabled in Australia. Australia now joins approximately 50 other countries worldwide with these gambling restrictions. The move impacts features like the Diamond Casino & Resort within the game.

headline: Lightspeed LA Lays Off Staff as It Shifts Last Sentinel's Creative Direction
summary: Lightspeed LA is making a significant shift in the creative direction of its game, Last Sentinel. This strategic change has unfortunately led to layoffs impacting some staff members. The developer is re-evaluating its vision for the upcoming title.

headline: Destin Daniel Cretton Admits He Was 'Sad' When Avengers: Kang Dynasty Got Canceled
summary: Director Destin Daniel Cretton expressed his sadness over the cancellation of 'Avengers: Kang Dynasty'. Marvel's carefully crafted buildup to Kang the Conqueror did not pan out as originally planned. Cretton was previously attached to direct the major Marvel film.

headline: Philips Electric Razor Deals: Save up to 60% at Amazon UK
summary: Amazon UK is offering significant discounts, up to 60% off, on Philips electric shavers. The sale includes popular models such as the Shaver Series 5000 and Series 3000X. Discounts also extend to Philips OneBlade accessories.

headline: Burnham invites Tories and Lib Dems to social care talks
summary: The Prime Minister is expected to make a speech regarding social care reform. He will emphasize the importance of finding common ground across party lines. Burnham is inviting Tories and Lib Dems to join discussions on fixing the social care system.

headline: Four women accuse Jared Leto of criminal sexual conduct when they were teenagers
summary: Jared Leto is facing allegations from a total of 10 women. Four women specifically accuse the actor and musician of criminal sexual conduct when they were teenagers. The claims bring scrutiny to Leto's past conduct with young women.

headline: Polanski says guillotine re-post was mistake but refuses to apologise
summary: The Green leader re-posted a photo depicting a man wearing a guillotine t-shirt. The t-shirt also featured the name 'Nigel'. Polanski later admitted the re-post was a mistake but has refused to issue an apology.

headline: Iran and US trade strikes, shattering brief lull in fighting
summary: US Central Command reported intercepting 'multiple' ballistic missiles fired by Iran. This exchange of strikes has shattered a recent brief lull in fighting. Tensions between Iran and the US escalate with renewed military action.
